validity.raw: Rack Rates valid: 1st January - 31st December 2026 (Rack file); STO Rates valid: 1st January - 31st December 2026 (STO file)

notes: This is a boutique guesthouse, NOT a Soroi property. Distinct from 'Manzili Mara' (Manzili Ndoto/Mara exclusive-use villa) which is also in this folder but is a separate property in the Maasai Mara - see manzili-mara-2026.json.
Meal plan structure: Bed & Breakfast per-adult-sharing rate is the base; Half Board is a supplement per adult/child; Day Use is 75% of the relevant rate.
Manzili House itself = 4 doubles (sleeps 8); Manzili Ndoto = 2 doubles (sleeps 4), exclusive use only.
Check-in 13:00, check-out 10:00 (except Half Board note: 'Check in 2pm / Check out 7pm' appears to apply specifically to the Day Use / Half Board product - ambiguous in source).

STO tier discount confirmed arithmetically: STO figures = Rack x 0.80 exactly across every line checked (e.g. $384 = $480 x 0.8, $520 = $650 x 0.8, $2,960 = $3,700 x 0.8, $1,600 = $2,000 x 0.8). This is an STO 20% tier.
